learning_outcomes.text: To provide students with knowledge about thermal system design and insulation technology.
To introduce application areas of thermal system design and insulation technology.
To teach problem-solving methods for thermal system design and insulation technology.

syllabus_topics: Concepts of thermal system design, introduction to green and smart building design
Exergy Analysis - basic concepts, physical exergy, potential exergy, chemical exergy, exergy balance and applications of exergy analysis in green buildings
Meeting the lighting needs of a space with photovoltaic panels, LED lighting system design
Solar energy supported radiant floor heating system technologies and design
Selection of materials used in cooling systems, solar energy supported cooling system design
Applications of solar energy supported LED lighting and radiant floor heating system technologies in green buildings
Introduction to thermal insulation technology and noise criteria, insulation materials
Thermal insulation, sound, humidity, fire insulation systems
Applications of thermal insulation technologies in residences
Calculations for meeting the power gains of electronic devices used in residences with wind turbines
Solar energy supported hot water system technologies and applications
Designs for meeting the power gains of electronic devices with wind turbines and applying rainwater harvesting in residences
